correctness.rationale: Goursat parametrizes additive subgroups of Z/p^n x Z/p^m uniquely as (a,b,c,t), 0<=c<=min(n-a,m-b), t unit mod p^c (c=0 trivial). Subbrace multiplicative closure reduces via generator products to p^(k+a)t≡p^(ell+b) mod p^c; ideal absorption by ambient (1,0),(0,1) reduces to c<=min(k,ell). Summing phi(p^c) units gives S=Σ[p^s+1_(k+a=ell+b) p^(k+a) max(0,M-k-a)] and I=Σp^min(M,k,ell), with M=min(n-a,m-b),s=min(M,k+a,ell+b). Dedekind iff k>ell,m=ell+1 or ell>k,n=k+1, using explicit nonideals otherwise. Independently generated all additive subgroups and tested ring/ideal closure in multiple small prime-power products (p=2,3), reproducing (18,18), other contrasts. Algebraic proof covers all p,n,m,k,ell in stated domain; C PASS.
